title: The Solar System chose fire over ice from the very beginning
hook: The Solar System chose fire over ice from the very beginning

beats.caption: The Solar System chose fire over ice from the very beginning
Here is how our solar system built its first solid planets.
beats.detail: It started with heat, not ice.
beats.narration: Here is how our solar system built its first solid planets from the very beginning.

beats.caption: Ancient iron meteorites show the system chose fire over ice.
beats.detail: Iron space rocks hold the secret.
beats.narration: Ancient iron meteorites reveal that the early solar system chose fire over ice.

beats.caption: Early building blocks were heat-forged beads instead of water-rich dust.
beats.detail: A clear divide in cosmic ingredients.
beats.narration: The raw materials were heat-forged rock beads, effectively excluding most water-rich dust.

beats.caption: This selective process happened within the first million years.
beats.detail: It was a very fast start.
beats.narration: This selective process happened incredibly quickly, within just the first million years of existence.

beats.caption: This means early bodies were built from hot, dry rock.
beats.narration: So, the first solid bodies were constructed almost entirely from that hot, dry rock.

beats.caption: Understanding this changes how we view planetary formation.
beats.detail: We are rewriting the early history.
beats.narration: Understanding this changes how we view the formation of our entire planetary neighborhood.
